methods.mean: Arithmetic mean of monthly simple returns
methods.risk_free: Month-aligned official French RF; each window uses its own mean
methods.value_weights: Static 2026-08-31 Yahoo company market-cap vector over the same 29 stocks
methods.subsamples: First 65 months and remaining 65; independently estimated
methods.return_policy: Use instructor price-derived returns on covered ordinary months; elsewhere Yahoo adjclose. For seven scoped mandatory distributions, replace the provider event-day gross with main-share plus child-share closing wealth, liquidate child shares at that close and reinvest in the main share; keep mainline exposure thereafter. Prices_us_monthly is a linked baseline-100 wealth index, not USD/share quotes.
methods.precision: Float64 without intermediate rounding; displays to three decimals
methods.primary_cleaning: No winsorization, trimming, ridge, pseudoinverse or clipping

long_only.method: Convex minimum variance at fixed positive excess mean, then budget normalization

limitations: Historical large-cap index cohort is not the full US equity market.
Keeping later index removals mitigates current-member survivorship selection; does not eliminate all survivorship bias or prove a quantified return correction.
Old DuPont is excluded for a historical data gap, leaving residual availability selection.
Index removal is not bankruptcy or stock-exchange delisting.
Spin-off child shares are valued and reinvested at the event close without costs; continuing company exposure excludes holding child shares indefinitely.
Other provider corporate-action adjustments and all publication-time vintages are not independently reconstructed.
Same-sample fitted Sharpe is not an independent performance estimate.
Subsample movement can reflect estimation error and changing market parameters.
Static sample-end capitalization weights are descriptive and contain future information for earlier months.
Borrowing, stock-borrow availability, funding and trading costs are excluded.
